decisions.reason: The source changes the orientation of bottom connectors on the main board; the sensor-board interboard connectors remain aligned along the top edge and are not necessarily affected.
The source decision is specific to the main board and does not revoke the independently specified L-shaped JST connector form on the power board.
The battery connector is on the power board, while the source changes bottom-connector orientation on the main board.
Changing main-board connector orientation does not alter the ESP32 module, breakout-hole placement, pin access, or breakout pitch requirements.
The source changes a mechanical connector orientation but does not change the interboard connector types, pinouts, pin order, or power topology.
The sensor-board connector inventory and electrical interfaces remain valid regardless of the changed orientation of bottom connectors on the main board.
The source does not identify the panel power-button connector or establish that it is one of the affected bottom connectors, so its type and control behavior remain unchanged.
Connector orientation does not change the specified monitoring IC, measured rails, channel allocation, or measurement coverage.
The mechanical orientation change does not affect I2C pull-ups, series resistors, cable length, bus speed, or signal conditioning.
The source does not identify the reset connector and does not change the BOOT/reset circuit behavior or capacitance requirements.
The source concerns bottom connector orientation and does not alter USB-C enumeration or programming requirements.
The main-board connector orientation change does not affect DCDC1 voltage configuration or the required 3.3V rail regulation.
